title.en_us: Piran Port: Ship Girls and Orders

text.zh_cn: 手持舰娘契约，对有足够空间的方块右键，召集一名舰娘。
text.en_us: Hold a ship-girl contract and right-click a block with enough free space to summon a ship girl.

text.zh_cn: 与舰娘互动可查看状态、对话与交易。潜行互动可切换其战斗 AI。
text.en_us: Interact with the ship girl to see status, dialogue and trades. Sneak-interact to toggle her combat AI.

text.zh_cn: 不潜行时手持黎塞留指挥剑右键舰娘，可依次切换跟随、驻守与巡逻。留意聊天栏中的当前命令。
text.en_us: Without sneaking, right-click her with Richelieu's command sword to cycle follow, hold position and patrol. Check chat for the current order.

text.zh_cn: 收到跟随命令后，舰娘会向发出命令的玩家移动；驻守时则停留在当前位置附近。
text.en_us: On a follow order the ship girl moves toward the player who issued it; on hold she stays near her current position.
